basic_details.job_title: TEXMiN Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Project Associate I / Project Associate II Posts
basic_details.short_information: Technology Innovation in Exploration & Mining Foundation (TEXMiN), IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, has 3 Project Associate-I or Project Associate-II positions (1 Geologist, 1 Geochemist, 1 Mineral Refining Expert) under the Global Supply Chain Observatory (GSCO Project), for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The fellowship is Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 37,000 for Project Associate-I and Rs. 33,000 to Rs. 42,000 for Project Associate-II, plus applicable HRA. Candidates need a four-year bachelor's degree in a listed discipline and must email their application to [email protected] by 21 Novemb

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to shortlisted candidates

age_limit.details: Under "Age and Relaxation (if any)", the notice states "40 Years". The notice does not mention any age relaxation or a cut-off date for counting age. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

qualification.details: The notice gives the desirable qualification as scholars having cleared: | National Eligibility Tests – CSIR UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE, or A selection process through National level exams conducted by Central Government Departments or their agencies and institutions. | The desirable qualification is not compulsory, but it decides which fellowship rate a candidate receives (see Pay and Tenure).

how_to_apply: Applications go by email only. The notice gives these steps:
Combine all documents into a single PDF file.
Include in the PDF: (i) CV, (ii) GATE/NET score card, (iii) self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates from class 10th, and (iv) proof of work experience (if any).
Write "Application for the position of Project Associate-I/II under the GSCO Project" in the subject of the email.
Send the email with the PDF to [email protected] by 21 November 2026.
Self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates from class 10th
important_instructions: Only 3 posts are available in total; one application covers either Project Associate-I or Project Associate-II, depending on eligibility. All candidates must make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: TEXMiN has 3 positions in total. Each position may be filled at the Project Associate-I or Project Associate-II level, depending on the candidate's eligibility. The notice states that "the total posts available are 3 only" and that candidates eligible for either level can apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for both levels is a Four Years Bachelor's degree in Geology, Geochemistry, Earth sciences, Materials, Minerals, Metallurgy, or Chemical Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university. The two levels differ in experience: The notice gives the desirable qualification as scholars having cleared: National Eligibility Tests – CSIR UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE, or A selection process through National level exams conducted by Central Government Departments or their agencies and institutions. The desirable qualification is not compulsory, but it decides which fellowship rate a candidate receives (see Pay and Tenure). Under "Age and Relaxation (if any)", the notice states "40 Years". The notice does not mention any age relaxation or a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.experience: Additional 2 years' experience in R & D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations, Scientific Activities and Services

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: TEXMiN pays a fellowship at two rates for each level, depending on whether the candidate meets the desirable qualification. Applicable HRA is added in every case.

content_sections.heading: TEXMiN Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: As printed in the notice, the selected Project Associates will: Conduct project research Prepare technical datasets/reports Support GSCO Research workflows Document methodologies Transfer knowledge Assist in commissioning and operation of the TEXMiN Satellite unit

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TEXMiN Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications go by email only. The notice gives these steps: Combine all documents into a single PDF file. Include in the PDF: (i) CV, (ii) GATE/NET score card, (iii) self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates from class 10th, and (iv) proof of work experience (if any). Write "Application for the position of Project Associate-I/II under the GSCO Project" in the subject of the email. Send the email with the PDF to [email protected] by 21 November 2026 . CV GATE/NET score card Self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates from class 10th Proof of work experience (if any)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirements of the project. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. The interview date has not yet been announced.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TEXMiN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Project Associate-I or Project Associate-II positions: 1 Geologist, 1 Geochemist and 1 Mineral Refining Expert.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TEXMiN Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed to [email protected] by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for TEXMiN Project Associate?
faq.answer: A Four Years Bachelor's degree in Geology, Geochemistry, Earth sciences, Materials, Minerals, Metallurgy, or Chemical Engineering or its equivalent is required. Project Associate-II also needs 2 years' R & D experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of TEXMiN Project Associate-I and II?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I gets Rs. 37,000/- with the desirable qualification or Rs. 30,000/- without it. Project Associate-II gets Rs. 42,000 or Rs. 33,000/-, respectively.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the TEXMiN fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicable HRA is paid in addition to the fellowship at every rate for both Project Associate-I and Project Associate-II.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for TEXMiN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email a single PDF with your CV, GATE/NET score card, self-attested marksheets and certificates from class 10th and proof of work experience (if any) to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the position of Project Associate-I/II under the GSCO Project" in the subject of the email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TEXMiN Project Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, whose date will be informed to them. No TA/DA is paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the TEXMiN Project Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a project post for 12 months, or until the completion of the GSCO Project, whichever comes earlier.
